# Jorge Quintero

> Forward Deployed Engineer · Fintech based in Medellín, Colombia. I turn your idea into software that drives your business. Software, APIs and integrations that scale: React, Next.js, Spring Boot, GCP and AI agents.

## About
- I am a developer with 7+ years of experience building web applications with React, Next.js and JavaScript. Today I work as a Forward Deployed Engineer in fintech: close to the business, turning real needs into software, APIs and integrations that scale.
- I enjoy the whole path from idea to product: interfaces and reusable components, API integrations, and backend work with Java and Spring Boot. I have worked in Agile teams alongside backend developers, QA engineers, product teams and business stakeholders, which made me a better teammate and communicator, not just a better coder.
- I chose software because it lets me turn ideas into something real while I keep discovering what I am capable of. I love learning, sharing knowledge and taking on challenges that help me build reliable, valuable products, like Mercatto SaaS, my own sales platform for supermarkets and fruit & vegetable stores.

## Projects
- Mercatto SaaS (2026): Point-of-sale and sales management SaaS for supermarkets and fruit & vegetable stores. Each business registers its own company, employees sign in with Google or Apple, and new staff wait for admin approval. Live: https://mercattosas.netlify.app/login
- Voix de la Beauté (2026): Beauty editorial platform with an admin panel, user roles and its own REST API on Firebase Functions written in TypeScript.
- VentasTell (2025): Sales software for a store that sells mobile phones and technology: products, customers and every sale in one place.
- Geek Platform (2021): Learning platform built as a team during the Academia Geek bootcamp, working in sprints with React, Redux and Firebase.
